MEMORY AND PRECISION, VERBATIM: 'MTT S4000 配备的 Tensor 核心算力、48GB 显存以及超高速卡间互连接口 MTLink，可以有效支持多种主流大语言模型训练' (48GB of memory, tensor-core compute, MTLink interconnect). Note carefully: this names the SUPPORTED PRECISIONS and attaches no number to any of them.

INTERCONNECT, VERBATIM: 'MTLink 是基于 MTT S4000 自研的卡间互连技术... 卡间互连 I/O 带宽达到 240GB/s' - 240 GB/s interconnect I/O bandwidth.

A full sweep of the extracted text found no absolute compute throughput number. The empty flops array on accelerators/moore-threads-s4000 is therefore CORRECT.
